resolutions.verifier_finding: Every number and the E-verdict ALIVE reproduce. The problem is the after-checks label. The group reports AC4 as PASS, with 'one stratum by construction: labelled only (as aiv_cc)', and label_after_checks_BuE ALIVE. Under D2 the AC4 cluster is the stratum, and the whole R1 denominator (82/86/168 streams) is one submission: one agent, one model, share 1.0. The prereg's AC4 says: if dominated, leave the dominant cluster out; a leave-out below min n caps the label at WEAK (UNTESTABLE_WITHOUT_DOMINANT). The only 'labelled only' exemption in the prereg is aiv_cc, a single-agent corpus. Track A applied the cap in the closest analogue: cc_local R1, repo share 0.999, leave-out of 1 stream, effect cap_weak, ceiling_after_checks WEAK (f1_bracket.json). Applied the same way, tbench2 R1 after checks is WEAK, and 'checks AC1-AC4 PASS' should read 'AC4 UNTESTABLE_WITHOUT_DOMINANT, capped at WEAK'. Caveat: the prereg mandates ACs only for A1 candidates and N1-N5 cells, so if the orchestrator treats the N6 cell as the raw E verdict, the cell stays ALIVE. This is a relabel; nothing needs recomputing. The notes are transparent that R1 covers one submission.
